amendment: Preserve the original user request and exact chart values as in v11; add general period-boundary inclusion and explicit post-filter aggregation rules. No expected values, case identifiers, or oracle feedback are provided to the application. Execute all three framework packages from a cohort-owned source snapshot, with per-trial before/after hashes and retained source bytes. For all time-bucket tasks, group original rows by derived period keys before reindexing; forbid equality joins between period boundaries and raw timestamps. Restore the upstream bounded code-repair loop with three retries instead of the earlier zero-retry evaluation configuration. All computation attempts, errors and model calls remain in raw event logs; no oracle feedback is supplied. Add explicit recursive serialization for Pandas Period values and PeriodIndex keys; v1 retains its previous refusal behavior. Apply period aggregation guidance only to requested temporal grouping; date filtering alone must not introduce date grouping. Expose a general period aggregation helper in the restricted generated-code namespace across A/B/C. It computes from supplied data and column names, without task identities or oracle values. Make the helper import Pandas through the sandbox import guard; apply formatting. The v18 cohort retains its original frozen sources.
